params.body:
Reporter: Ilse (dealer team), 2026-09-16. Instellingen, Showroom, "Download" ends in a 500 in production.

## Why the code cannot fix it alone

Browsershot 5 starts a Chrome that puppeteer downloads on `npm ci` (its postinstall) into `~/.cache/puppeteer` of the user PHP runs as (`forge`). That binary lives on the server, not in the repo. `puppeteer` is already a runtime dependency in `package.json` (not a devDependency), so the deploy's `npm ci` installs it even with `--omit=dev`; what is missing on the box is the Chrome download itself, its system libraries, or the path PHP-FPM resolves.

## What this PR changes

- **Honest failure.** `Screenshot::jpeg()` wraps whatever Browsershot throws in `ScreenshotUnavailable`; its message carries the diagnosis (which node and Chrome were tried, and the command that installs them). `SettingsController::downloadShowroom` catches it, removes any half-built archive and slides, `report()`s the exception, and sends the dealer back to the Showroom tab with the notification "De download is nu niet mogelijk, de beheerder is verwittigd" (`showroom.download_unavailable`, nl/fr/en/de) instead of a white page.
- **A status check.** `Screenshot::diagnose()` resolves Chrome the way Browsershot does (`BROWSERSHOT_CHROME`, else `puppeteer.executablePath()` from the project's `node_modules`) and says whether the file exists, never starting a browser. `IntegrationChecks` gains the service `showroom` ("Showroom-download (Chrome)") on the admin Koppelingen panel; `php artisan stocklist:smoke showroom` (and `--all`) prints the same line.
- CUTOVER.md aftercare item rewritten as the server checklist below; finding `2026-09-16-showroom-download-chrome.md`; rule R S2-7.16.

## Server checklist (Shane, as `forge`, in `/home/forge/stocklistdealer-um9ljxus.on-forge.com/current`)

1. `node -v` (PATH via `.nvmrc`; Browsershot uses `node`/`npm` from PATH unless `BROWSERSHOT_NODE`/`BROWSERSHOT_NPM` are set in `.env`).
2. `ls node_modules/puppeteer` (must exist; runtime dependency, installed by `npm ci`).
3. `node -e "console.log(require('puppeteer').executablePath())"` then `ls -l` that path. That is the Chrome Browsershot starts. Default `~/.cache/puppeteer/chrome/...` of `forge`, unless `PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD` was set or `npm ci` ran with `--ignore-scripts`.
4. If the file is missing: `npx puppeteer browsers install chrome` (once; the cache is outside the release directory, so it survives deploys). If you want it elsewhere, set `PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR` both in the deploy script (for `npm ci`) and in PHP-FPM's environment (for the button), otherwise they look in two places.
5. If Chrome does not start ("error while loading shared libraries"): `sudo npx puppeteer browsers install chrome --install-deps`, or apt the libs it names (`libnss3 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libgbm1 libasound2 libxkbcommon0`, ...).
6. Fallback: `apt install chromium` and `BROWSERSHOT_CHROME=/usr/bin/chromium` in `.env`; the panel line then says "(BROWSERSHOT_CHROME)".
7. Verify: `php8.5 artisan stocklist:smoke showroom` must print `✓ showroom`; then "Nu controleren" on the Koppelingen panel; then the Download button itself (a zip with one jpeg per showroom vehicle).

## Tests

`ShowroomDownloadTest` (notify path with a throwing fake, the wrapped Browsershot exception with a nonexistent node, the diagnosis per missing step), `IntegrationSmokeTest` (check ok for a present binary, fail with the install command for an absent one, the line in the smoke output and the nl label), `IntegrationStatusTest`, `LanguageParityTest`, `ScreenshotTest`, `RulesCoverageTest`, `RulesIdentityTest`, `CompiledViewsTest`, `SmokeTest --filter 'showroom|settings'`: all green (the pre-existing Spanish gap stays incomplete). Ran the real probe on the Mac once: `✗ showroom puppeteer expects Chrome at .../node_modules/puppeteer/.local-chromium/... but it is not there; ... run npx puppeteer browsers install chrome` in 316 ms, so the diagnosis reads correctly without fakes.

No screenshot: the notification is the existing `ui.notify` toast via `layouts/toast.blade.php` (`message_tone: error`), pinned by session assertions; rendering the full settings page in a test dump did not finish within the pace budget.
params.title: Showroom download: honest error and a status check for Chrome, with the server checklist
